_comment: Every measured number in paper/rote.tex, bound to the frozen certification document it was transcribed from. Verified by paper/scripts/verify-claims.mjs; see paper/README.md. `paper_anchor` must appear verbatim in rote.tex; `literals` are the measurement literals this claim evidences; `source_excerpt` must appear verbatim in `source`. Note that the T-documents use en dashes in intervals where the paper uses LaTeX en dashes.

claims.statement: Rote reduces logical input tokens by 83.1% against Browser Use 0.13.7 on corrected B2.
Billed cost falls 68.2% at exact-oracle parity.
Mean billed cost per task: $0.0038 for Rote against $0.0120 for the baseline.
Mean logical tokens per task: 8,353 for Rote against 49,324 for the baseline.
claims.note: The paper rounds the frozen 8,352.7 and 49,324.1 to whole tokens.

claims.statement: Rote's cumulative logical-input growth is 37.2% slower than the baseline's on the real-page WordPress curve.
The 9-step WP-N09 cell reduces logical input by 14.3%.
The 17-, 21- and 25-step cells reduce logical input by 26–28%.
claims.note: The three deep cells measure 26.6% (N17), 27.5% (N21) and 26.3% (N25); the paper states the range they span.

claims.statement: Diff observations are a 99.6% median render-size reduction against their preceding grounded base.
Cache-stable prefix routing cuts billed cost 20.5% on the 25-step cell.
No silent failure was observed under drift; the 95% upper bound is 4.1%.
The offline predictor reaches 99.4% kind+target accuracy over 1,520 warm steps (Wilson 98.9–99.7%).
Kind-only accuracy is 96.5% over 2,805 live WordPress steps.
At confidence ≥ 0.9 the predictor covers 62.4% of steps at 99.8% precision.
At confidence ≥ 0.95 the predictor covers 62.2% of steps at 100% precision.
The lowest-scoring confidence bucket (mean 0.33) still realizes 98.7% accuracy — the under-calibration the paper reports.
claims.note: The paper's approximate 99% for scores near 0.33 is this bucket's 98.7%.

claims.statement: Under 60-transition SPA endurance, 100% of post-bootstrap observations are served as diffs.
claims.source_excerpt: | Post-base steps served as diffs | 100% (60/60 per run) |

exempt.reason: The confidence level of every reported interval — a property of the method, not a measurement. docs/03-benchmark.md fixes it.
The seeded bootstrap's resample count — a property of the method, fixed in docs/03-benchmark.md so output is byte-stable.
